scenes.basis: 22:1 "Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you" - the speech is from the stairs of 21:40 to the Jerusalem crowd; Tarsus, Damascus and the temple trance are memories, never settings
22:24 "the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging" - the riot and the barracks name no place; they continue the Jerusalem arrest
22:30 "he freed him from the bonds, and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them" - the council is the Jerusalem Sanhedrin
